items.titleZh: 威廉姆斯车队哀悼艾伦·琼斯逝世
items.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯车队对艾伦·琼斯的逝世深感悲痛，他是车队真正的传奇人物，与弗兰克·威廉姆斯和帕特里克·海德建立了非凡的联系，并在1980年赢得了车队首个车手世界冠军。

media.altZh: 威廉姆斯车队哀悼艾伦·琼斯逝世 · 第 1 张
威廉姆斯车队哀悼艾伦·琼斯逝世 · 第 2 张

items.originalTitle: We are deeply saddened by the passing of Alan Jones. A true Williams legend, Alan formed an extraordinary bond with Frank Williams and Patrick Head an...
items.summaryEn:
We are deeply saddened by the passing of Alan Jones.
A true Williams legend, Alan formed an extraordinary bond with Frank Williams and Patrick Head and made history by winning our first Drivers’ World Championship in 1980. 
He set the standard for Williams champions: a fast, uncompromising racer with a challenger mentality who loved motor racing and dedicated his life to it.
He will be dearly missed, and we send our love and thoughts to his family and friends.
detailZh:
我们深感悲痛地宣布艾伦·琼斯的逝世。
艾伦·琼斯是威廉姆斯车队真正的传奇人物，他与弗兰克·威廉姆斯和帕特里克·海德建立了非凡的联系，并在1980年赢得了我们首个车手世界冠军。
他树立了威廉姆斯车队冠军的标准：一个快速、坚定不移的赛车手，具有挑战者心态，热爱赛车，并将一生奉献给了这项运动。
我们将永远怀念他，并向他的家人和朋友致以我们的爱和思念。
detailEn:
We are deeply saddened by the passing of Alan Jones.
A true Williams legend, Alan formed an extraordinary bond with Frank Williams and Patrick Head and made history by winning our first Drivers’ World Championship in 1980. 
He set the standard for Williams champions: a fast, uncompromising racer with a challenger mentality who loved motor racing and dedicated his life to it.
He will be dearly missed, and we send our love and thoughts to his family and friends.
